name: Jodee Huish
imageAlt: Jodee Huish website shown on a desktop display
body: We built a fully custom website for Jodee Huish, an incredible artist based in Arizona, who needed a digital space to showcase her work.

Now, her art comes to life with interactive video previews, a beautifully designed online store, and a seamless platform where clients can explore her portfolio, learn her story, and easily purchase her pieces. For Jodee, the site is more than a gallery — it’s a go-to destination that finally reflects the quality and emotion of her work.
result: Traffic increased by 13% in the first 60 days.
